title: LinkedIn Jobs & US Hiring Monitor Output
description: Structured public LinkedIn job records with company data, normalized dates and salaries, descriptions, skills, benefits, LinkedIn job URLs, external application URLs, and search-result traceability.

transportSummary.title: Source transport and cost safeguards
transportSummary.description: Transport, explicit proxy usage, bounded source time, source attempts, cooldown/recovery counts and terminal failures. No automatic paid fallback is enabled.

runSummary.title: Scan coverage and limits
runSummary.description: Per-search coverage, failed requests, saved/charged job counts, and whether the bounded observation batch completed. A capped scan is not complete market coverage.

jobChanges.title: Saved watchlist comparison (JSON)
jobChanges.description: Available only when watchlistName is set. Check baselineCommitted and status before consuming changes. First successful scan initializes a baseline, not new-job alerts.

jobChangesCsv.title: Saved watchlist comparison (CSV)
jobChangesCsv.description: One row per changed field, or one observation row when there is no tracked field change. Available only with watchlistName; JSON contains full coverage and commit metadata.

results.title: Public LinkedIn job listing records
results.description: Clean public LinkedIn job records. jobUrl always identifies the LinkedIn listing; applyUrl is reserved for a separately published employer application link. A record is saved and charged only when it contains usable job data.
